data.rationale: The proposal only covers the first step of the true workflow (Booking.com destination and date search). It leaves out choosing a hotel, the xe.com conversion and the email draft. It hardcodes the dates and has no parameters for city, dates, currency or traveler, so it can't be automated as a general workflow.
